Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model

Class PartidaDTO

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.PartidaDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PartidaDTO extends Object implements Serializable
The class PartidaDTO represents a game item in the game. This class contains information about the name of the game, the number of players, the panel matrix, the unit matrix, and the team list. Represents the array of panels, the array of units, and the list of teams participating in the game.
